verdict.rationale: PayPal Invoicing lets merchants create and send itemized invoices that are paid on a secure, PayPal-hosted payment page. Invoices can be shared by secure URL, branded email or QR code, and merchants can configure automatic payment reminders; the Invoicing REST API and the send_invoice_reminder agent tool add programmatic control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on reminder scheduling options.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders

citations.quote: PayPal Invoicing lets merchants and partners create and send itemized invoices and get paid through a secure PayPal payment page, without building their own payment flow.
Merchants can share invoices via a secure URL, merchant-branded email, or scannable QR code, and configure automatic payment reminders.
The Invoicing REST API helps you create, update, send, and manage invoices programmatically from your backend systems.
